title: [FEATURE] Don't allow rate limit to hit in the middle of completing a request
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

The agent hits the rate limit while it's working on a task. This can break the project.

### Proposed Solution

Make it, so the agent stops after it completes the task it's running while the rate limit hit.
